description: Angular component for displaying and managing a table of geofencing zone groups with functionalities like add, delete, sort, and popover management.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldZoneDatasource
classes.description: Data source class for geofencing zone group table, extending TbTableDatasource.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes sort change subscription after view initialization.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers callback for touch event; empty implementation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form array, returns error if any zone has null UUID.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Removes a zone from the form array.

methods.name: manageZone
methods.description: Handles adding or editing a zone via popover.

methods.name: updateDataSource
methods.description: Sorts data and loads into data source.

methods.name: updateErrorText
methods.description: Checks for invalid entity IDs and updates error message.

methods.name: getZonesObject
methods.description: Converts form array values into a zones object.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form array from zones object.

methods.name: populateZonesFormArray
methods.description: Creates form controls from zones object.

methods.name: updateEntityNameMap
methods.description: Fetches entity names for referenced entities.

methods.name: fetchEntityNames
methods.description: Fetches entity names asynchronously and updates map.

methods.name: getSortValue
methods.description: Returns sortable string based on column.

methods.name: sortData
methods.description: Sorts zone data based on current sort order.
